sela.complete.speaker: Sela Venn
sela.complete.text: Couplings are steady. I’ve isolated that pulse, but Ivo wants a look at the echo. Two repair fittings at your workbench will finish the job. Then your little ship can be a home again.

responses.text: Does this mean I can take off?

sela.return.speaker: Sela Venn
sela.return.text: That’s the same rhythm. Six beats, a pause, then six more. Wear and tear doesn’t usually have a favorite song. I’ll contain the interference. Take these fittings, and your pay. You’ve earned a quiet evening.

sela.active.speaker: Sela Venn
sela.active.text: Amber trail markers lead northwest through Fernwood. The old array is past the fallen mast. Bring back its echo module. And don’t let the mosslings convince you they’re starving. They’re very good at that.

sela.start.speaker: Sela Venn
sela.start.text: You must be the pilot of that lovely old rust-bird. Your drive is fine. Navigation… less fine. Funny thing: our lamps started flickering in exactly the same rhythm. There’s an abandoned survey array out in Fernwood. Fancy taking a walk?

sela.accepted.speaker: Sela Venn
sela.accepted.text: Follow the amber markers northwest. Your journal and map have the location. Take your time. Pick a few lanterncaps, watch the little creatures. A problem can wait long enough for a good walk.

sela.done.speaker: Sela Venn
sela.done.text: There. Quiet again. Ivo wants to see what we found — apparently he’s been listening to plants now. Your workbench is ready when you get back aboard.

sela.town.speaker: Sela Venn
sela.town.text: Mosslight Harbor. Eighty-six people, three working kettles, one extremely opinionated weather station. Oren stocks the necessities. Neri supplies the reasons to stay.

responses.text: Sounds like a good place to be grounded.

sela.flight.speaker: Sela Venn
sela.flight.text: The fittings will stabilize navigation. When you’re ready, take the pilot seat and chart a course to Orren. And, hey — come back, alright?

oren.start.speaker: Oren Vale
oren.start.text: A new face! Welcome. If it powers a torch, fills a belly, or stops a worrying rattle, I probably sell it. I also buy lanterncaps, cloud quartz, and clean salvage. Fair prices, modest gossip.

responses.text: What should I take on the trail?

oren.trail.speaker: Oren Vale
oren.trail.text: A trailcake helps with long runs. Batteries and repair fittings are always useful. Keep three lanterncaps for Ivo before you sell the rest. He’s paying well for field notes, too.

ivo.done.speaker: Ivo Quill
ivo.done.text: Your echo module matches the lanterncap pulses exactly. And the array isn’t broadcasting — it’s listening. Whatever your ship picked up, the forest heard it first. That is… a lot to think about.

responses.text: I think I’ll stay and listen.

ivo.return.speaker: Ivo Quill
ivo.return.text: Two observations and three lanterncaps! No frightened creatures, no collecting jars full of unhappy things. Exactly the kind of science I like. Here’s your field stipend, and some tea from Neri.

ivo.active.speaker: Ivo Quill
ivo.active.text: Observe two different mosslings from a few paces away. They bolt if you sprint right at them. Three lanterncaps as well, please. The blue ones grow beside the woodland trail and pond.

ivo.complete.speaker: Ivo Quill
ivo.complete.text: The samples are settling nicely. Mosslings pause before every lanterncap pulse. I wonder what they can hear that we can’t.

ivo.start.speaker: Ivo Quill
ivo.start.text: Oh! A traveler. Excellent. Would you help me study the mosslings? Observe two different ones, and gather three lanterncaps. No fighting, no cages. Just pay attention. It’s surprisingly rare.

ivo.accepted.speaker: Ivo Quill
ivo.accepted.text: You already have a field scanner in your suit. Approach at a walk and use Observe. The meadow and Glasswater Pond are good places to look. I’ve marked them on your map.

ivo.signal.speaker: Ivo Quill
ivo.signal.text: Six beats. The lanterncaps do that at night! Before the arrays were abandoned, a surveyor wrote: “We thought we were alone because we only listened for voices.” Tamsin might know where the rest of that journal is.

ivo.thanks.speaker: Ivo Quill
ivo.thanks.text: Here’s the strange part: the gills glow a heartbeat before the array pulses. Not an echo. A reply? Come back after you’ve helped Sela. We’ll compare notes.

neri.gift.speaker: Neri Bloom
neri.gift.text: New arrivals get a cup on the house. House rule. You look like someone whose ship has decided to become a garden ornament. Sit for a minute. The universe can be strange after tea.

responses.text: I could use that. Thank you.

neri.start.speaker: Neri Bloom
neri.start.text: Welcome back. The kettle’s warm. At lunch, half the settlement ends up out here pretending they didn’t come for a second cake.

neri.home.speaker: Neri Bloom
neri.home.text: Honestly? It’s mostly people noticing when you’ve been gone. Take the long way back from the woods sometime, then come tell me what you found.

tamsin.return.speaker: Tamsin Reed
tamsin.return.text: That’s Elian’s recording. The first surveyor. We kept the lamp burning because… well, it felt wrong to turn it off. What did it say?

responses.text: “Leave a light for whoever comes next.”

tamsin.active.speaker: Tamsin Reed
tamsin.active.text: Blue markers, east of the pond. The tunnel is tucked under the ridge. Your suit lamp will come on inside. Check the old desk at the back. No danger in there. Just time.

tamsin.complete.speaker: Tamsin Reed
tamsin.complete.text: We’ll keep a copy in the community hall. There’s an overlook southeast of town if you need to think. On a clear night you can see the rings above the ridge.

tamsin.start.speaker: Tamsin Reed
tamsin.start.text: If you’re heading out, there’s an old survey tunnel beyond Glasswater. I found a lamp still burning. Someone lived there before we built the harbor. Would you look for a recording? I’d like to know their name.

responses.text: I’ll find what they left behind.

tamsin.accepted.speaker: Tamsin Reed
tamsin.accepted.text: Follow the blue markers east, past Glasswater Pond. The tunnel’s entrance is beneath the pale stone arch. And walk around the mosslings, please. They were here first.

tamsin.advice.speaker: Tamsin Reed
tamsin.advice.text: Amber leads to the array. Blue leads to the tunnel. Stone cairns lead to Farlook Ridge. The pond is shallow by the edges, but take the path around it. Save a little breath for the view.
